question:
Select the option in which the terms share the same relationship as that shared by the given pair of terms.

DMO : WNL
solution:
The alphabets and their corresponding (reverse) are as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7631f0fd92c2cf90bcb3e98f8fc1b330fa8bb1b068bb1b31fb16690796e6aca4.png] 

 

Given: DMO : WNL

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fb59695b7f3183a2ae7ff775416c777bd2d13abac977230dbe60b619da5fc2f2.png] 

First we will check all the options:

1) GHI : TSR

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fd4d10007df6fe6378eb172658396dde35012f550bdaea04e8e543af93fb253e.png] 

This is true.

 

2) CFH : XUT

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3151b5b6fb904568ac1d12a5204f074d4cc3008afb7fb42645eaef2e62c1d7cc.png] 

which is not equal to XUT. This is not true.

 

3) DQG : ELP

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/49d6924b677e0518f4f2e60d502a84df8f63d0bd476072e8ac7098ccf9eafc12.png] 

which is not equal to ELP. This is not true.

 

4) ZAT : EGD

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cd1152ebceb422671c2a82175b40367ae7d765a0a96f540bccdcc5d3e4596635.png] 

which is not equal to EGD. This is not true.

 

Hence, the correct answer is '__**option 1**__'.
